## Relevant checks

<!-- Keep applicable items only. Do not claim an unrun check passed. / 只保留适用项，未运行不写通过。 -->

- Behavior change: implementation first, then necessary local automated and real QA; CI only as manual final validation / 行为修改：先完成实现，再完成必要本地自动与实际 QA；CI 只作手动最终验证
- Bug fix: reproduction, root cause, old failure detected by the regression, CI discovery or remaining manual gap / 缺陷修复：复现、根因、回归如何发现旧故障、CI 接线或人工验证缺口
- Docs changed: relevant link/pairing checks; review existing paired docs before refreshing confirmation / 文档修改：相关引用/配对检查；已有配对核对后更新确认
- Lasting contract or tradeoff changed: update its owning card / decision; ordinary fixes need no new record / 长期契约或取舍改变：更新对应卡或决定；普通修复不新建记录
